The project at a glance, one card per topic. Pick a tile to dig in.

```{r}
#| label: tile-css
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# Quarto's bundled Bootstrap is pruned (no grid utilities), so the grid,
# tile, and stretched-link styles are all defined here.
htmltools::tags$style(htmltools::HTML(
  "
  .explore-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
  }
  .explore-tile {
    position: relative;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
  }
  .explore-tile:hover { border-color: var(--bs-primary, #0d6efd); }
  .explore-tile h3 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; font-size: 1.25rem; }
  .explore-tile h3 a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--bs-primary, #0d6efd); }
  .explore-tile p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #495057; }
  .explore-tile .stretched-link::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 1;
  }
"
))
```
